title: Design System: Field Gym — Magnetic Plotting Table

display.purpose: Product identity and major operational headings.

motion.name: timeline-playback
motion.purpose: Connect prescribed activation schedules to coil opacity and field state without blocking interaction.

components.name: Primary Rail Action
components.description: Loads geometry or commits the rail's primary operation.

components.name: Instrument Field
components.description: Compact numeric or textual geometry control.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:4px;color:#5c686c;font:800 .67rem 'DejaVu Sans Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-field input{min-height:35px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #506168;border-radius:0;background:#fffefa;color:#152127;font:400 .9rem 'Noto Sans',sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #006cff;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Tool Rail
components.description: Continuous square instrument controls with ruled separation.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid #152127;background:#fffefa}.ds-rail button{height:48px;padding:0 13px;border:0;border-right:1px solid #b9c2c0;border-radius:0;background:#fffefa;color:#152127;font:800 .72rem 'DejaVu Sans Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-rail button:hover{background:#152127;color:#fffefa}.ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #006cff;outline-offset:-3px}

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Tabular continuity result with label and measured value.

components.name: Qualitative Model Notice
components.description: Persistent model-boundary notice shown on desktop and mobile.
components.html: QUALITATIVE MODELNormalized vacuum field · no plasma or reactor engineering

narrative.overview: Field Gym behaves like a physical laboratory plotting surface: crisp working stock, hard instrument rails, colored current paths, and measurements sharing one continuous desk. It refuses the generic dark neon simulation dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt for positive drive and vermilion for reversal or warning
Aqua field traces over a pale measurement grid
State shown through geometry, timelines, and explicit numerical readouts

rules.name: The Polarity Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means positive drive; vermilion means reversal or warning.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Field Aqua belongs to computed field traces, not ordinary buttons or labels.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from ruled planes, not persistent card shadows or glass surfaces.

dos: Do keep the qualitative-model boundary visible near the work surface.
Do make current polarity, inactive state, selected geometry, and current time visually distinct.
Do preserve direct access to numeric geometry and schedule fields alongside canvas interaction.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a dark neon sci-fi dashboard.
Don't replace operating regions with rounded cards or pills.
Don't imply circuit feasibility, plasma equilibrium, or reactor performance through visual language.
